issues.description: Bitmap24 constructor parameter types are inconsistent in the template: the header declares `Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height)` but the implementation defines `Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height)`. This can cause a compile/link error in the example program because the declared constructor signature does not match the defined one. The solution repository uses `int` consistently.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent between declaration and definition. Match the solution by changing the template header to `Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height);` (or alternatively change the .cpp definition to `long`, but keep both identical).
